Consider two sets of $27$ paired observations ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{27},$ and ${y}_{1},{y}_{2},…,{y}_{27}.$ You are given that

$$
\begin{aligned} & {\sum }_{i=1}^{27}{x}_{i}=540,\,{\sum }_{i=1}^{27}{y}_{i}=567, \\  & {\sum }_{i=1}^{27}{x}_{i}^{2}=12\,050,\,{\sum }_{i=1}^{27}{y}_{i}^{2}=14\,107.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the sum of the squared deviations from the mean for the points ${x}_{i}.$
